caption:
The warmest thing on the avenue came in a paper cone. I have crossed it for less.

#newyorkcity #chestnuts #streetfood
alt_text: Close-up at a steaming street cart: a hand of polished grey-ivory marble with thin gold veins and a gold cuff, from an amber coat sleeve, takes a paper cone of roasted chestnuts from a vendor's hand in a grey fingerless glove; a yellow taxi blurs behind.
